usedFor: CallHub runs call and text outreach, and “New Text Message Received” can start a template when someone replies.

bestTemplate.name: “New Booking Created” in Recras, then “Create Contact” in CallHub
bestTemplate.why: A new booking adds the person to CallHub as a contact, ready for your next outreach.

watchOut: “Update a contact” in CallHub needs the contact's phone number or contact ID from an earlier step.
